value.rationale: The minimum two-cell size for every foreground and intervening background feature is a natural imaging-resolution constraint. The complete exact identifiability cutoff and unique first collision distinguish a design class not answered by the unrestricted N=12 or foreground-only N=19 thresholds; comparing the four-run N=22 class yields a nonmonotone component-count onset. The explicit universal construction controls how resolution can force ambiguity. The finite threshold is structural and acquisition-relevant, not a randomly chosen isolated computation.
